curve_footing_note: Steps 0..15 evaluate pre-rebalance experts at global_alpha_moe=0.3000 (eval_footing=per_step_pre_rebalance_alpha_0.30); row 16 evaluates post-rebalance experts with held-in calibrated global_alpha_moe (eval_footing=post_rebalance_calibrated_alpha_eval).
frozen_base_q8_0_eval_note: val_bpb_384d and val_bpb_768d are intentionally constant across steps 0..16 because the Q8_0 384D/768D base model is frozen during Shell-2 sparse MoE training.
step16_jump_magnitude_explanation: Steps 0..15 run analytical softmax-CE updates on 24 held-in train sequences at fixed global_alpha_moe=0.3000, reducing train_mean_ce_nats by avg -0.001085/step (3.539445->3.523165) and val_bpb_3shell by avg -0.000011/step (0.099870->0.099705). Between step 15 and row 16 (without an extra gradient step), v72_2_rebalance_and_measure_experts re-centers router_centroid_768 and balances biases for 16/16 expert utilization (load_balance_cv=0.648773), and held-in calib_slice (10 train seqs, 0% val overlap) searches alpha_grid (0.005..=0.50), scaling global_alpha_moe 1.667x from 0.3000 to 0.5000. Because v72_2_apply_shell2_moe_experts_to_logits scales the learned sparse w_out_vocab_sparse delta linearly by global_alpha_moe (eff_scale = global_alpha_moe * alpha_gate * gate_w * (1 + 0.15*swiglu_mod)), this 1.667x multiplier plus rebalanced Top-2 routing produces row 16's discrete step-change: -0.012583 train_mean_ce_nats (~11.6x per-step slope, to 3.510582) and -0.000118 val_bpb_3shell (~10.7x per-step slope, to 0.099587 / val_ppl_3shell 52.844190).
